question: Does one further Dusk-only mediator payout step close the exact v7 policy shortfall without RandomBuild or reliability regression?

competingOptions.statement: Both Dusk routes gain a second viable policy while Ash routes, retention and all guardrails stay clear.
A route remains underpowered or the Dusk-only payout causes RandomBuild movement, collapse or added reliability faults.

estimands.functionalSeparation: Named diagonal interaction lower 95% bound at least 0.25 SD; every off-diagonal upper bound below 0.25.
estimands.panelActivation: Named consumer response in AB minus B, standardised by pooled consumer response; lower 95% bound at least 0.25 SD.
estimands.policySensitivity: At least eight independent policies per package and split apply and consume the mediator with positive consumer activation.
estimands.reliability: Paired candidate-minus-live added stalls by policy, aspect, vow and seed; any added stall or simulator error fails.
estimands.reachability: Legacy rewards acquire, play and activate both components for at least two distinct policies per applicable aspect/vow and split.
estimands.policyViability: Each route has at least two witness policies whose full-seed win rate exceeds RandomBuild arm 2 by at least 0.35.
estimands.retention: Both route best-policy rates per grid are within 0.10 and their witness sets differ.
estimands.globalMovement: Candidate-minus-live RandomBuild arm-2 point movement is at most 0.10 per grid; a bound-overlapping interval extends.

successRule.functionalSeparation: All four diagonals and twelve off-diagonals pass discovery and held-out evidence.
successRule.packageActivation: All four packages meet activation, witness, aspect-separation, reliability and duration gates in both splits.
successRule.globalMovement: Every held-out RandomBuild movement is within 0.10.
successRule.reliability: No candidate-added stall and zero candidate/live simulator errors.
successRule.reachability: Both packages per aspect meet the policy witness rule in every grid and split.
successRule.c2: RandomBuild arm 2 is below 0.50 and both route endpoints have at least two policies with a gap of at least 0.35.
successRule.retention: Both route endpoints remain within 0.10 of the top and use distinct witness sets.
successRule.vow5: Every top route-policy win rate is at most 0.90.

cheapestDiscriminatingExperiment: Run 32-pair separation and panels, paired 32-seed controls, then paired candidate/live 64-policy by 8-seed landscapes. Extend only non-fault shortfalls.
inconclusiveRule: A threshold-overlapping control or non-fault route shortfall extends to the frozen maximum on the same cohort. At the maximum it rejects. No candidate, policy logic or estimand changes.
stopRule: Reject immediately on functional-separation, activation, global-movement, candidate-added-stall, simulator-error, C2, retention or Vow-5 failure. Detector mutations remain forbidden until discovery and independent validation pass.
